jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor in Black Hole Astrophysics
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and accomplished Postdoc scientist to work at the intersection of theory, simulation, and data analysis in black hole astrophysics for a four-year position, commencing on 1 March 2027.

  Information about the Department can be found at: The Niels Bohr International Academy – University of Copenhagen

  Your job

  The Assistant Professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regard to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Assistant professorship. To a limited extent this may also include performance of other duties

  Specifically, the chosen applicant is required to work on the following problems

  1) Are extragalactic jets seen throughout the Universe really powered by black hole spin energy and can we prove it with polarimetric observations?

  2) How do gravity, radiation, and high-energy particles interact to determine the structure and dynamics of accretion disks and the jet launching region around low luminosity AGN?

  3) What is the best way to use sparse and noisy observations from Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) arrays to precisely measure the properties of black holes and their astrophysical environments?

  Profile

  We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following competencies:

  Essential experience and skills:

  In order to pursue these questions, the chosen candidate must have a substantial record of leadership in the global Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) collaboration as well as a role in the project team for the proposed NASA Black Hole Explorer (BHEX) mission.

  The chosen candidate must have a proven track record in the analysis of VLBI data, running and interpreting General Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamic (GRMHD) simulations, and building semi-analytic models of black hole accretion and jet launching for comparison with extremely high-resolution EHT data. This position is for four years.

   

  Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory, but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

  
 General criteria apply to the appointment of Assistant Professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

  For Assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf.
 
 Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

   

  Questions

  For further inquiries about the position can be made to: phdamg@nbi.ku.dk

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 4 years. The starting date is 1 of March, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  Terms of employment
 The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of

  Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,900 DKK/approx. 5,300 EUR (August 2026-level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  Application procedure
 Your online application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position. 	
• A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do. 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications - please describe and document: 	 		
• Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students 		
• Teaching experience 		
• Formal pedagogical training 	 	 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers   Deadline for applications:  17 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 

  After the expiry date of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  Interviews/trial lectures will be held from 9 December 2026.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.

The role
You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).

What you will do

• Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
• Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
• Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
• Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
• Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
• Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
• Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
• Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
• Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months

• You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.
• You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
• You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
• You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
• If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
• You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.

What we are looking for
We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.

• At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.
• Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.
• Strong C++ programming skills.
• Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.
• Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.
• Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.
• Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.
• Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.
• Professional fluency in English.
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Who you are
You are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.

• You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
• You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
• You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
• You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
• You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.

Our hiring process
Our process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:

1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Partner
A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal Engineer
A deeper conversation about your technical background, C++ and embedded experience, motor-control experience where relevant, and your approach to solving engineering problems.

3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COO
A hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team, similar to a pair-programming exercise. The focus is on understanding your technical approach, problem-solving and how you collaborate.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.

4. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto’s technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.

Please apply even if you don't meet every single point. We are interested in what you can bring to the team, your ability to learn and your motivation to work on the challenges we are solving.

We are an ambitious and collaborative team, and we value people who take ownership, challenge ideas constructively and want to help build both great technology and a great company.This is not a role where everything is already defined. You will have the opportunity to:

1. Introductory conversation with People & Culture
A chance for us to learn more about you and for you to learn more about Robotto, the role and what we are looking for.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager
A deeper conversation about your experience, skills and approach to the role

Depending on the position, this may include a technical discussion, practical exercise, case or live scenario relevant to the work you would be doing at Robotto.

A conversation with a member of our leadership team to explore mutual fit and give you another opportunity to learn about Robotto and where we are going

Interested?

Equal opportunity
At Robotto, we want to build a team where different experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or other characteristics protected by applicable law.

You’re a great match if

Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

Experience building systemic or open-world games

You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

jobs.occupation: Technical Solution Designer - Clinical Trial Mgmt & Clinical Trial Supply in IT
jobs.description:
Are you a Technical Solution Designer with deep understanding of Clinical Trial Management and Clinical Trial Supply? Do you think holistically, act with ambition, and find technical solutions to accelerate clinical trial oversight?

Can you design and implement configurations for SaaS applications to support trials?

If so, you may be our new T_echnical Solution Designer._

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our context

This position is based in our Global IT organization. In Global IT, we have spent the past five years building and maturing a product-driven organization. We operate with a strong focus on product management and lifecycle thinking, where long-lived teams take full ownership- from problem discovery to solution delivery and continuous improvement - ensuring we address real business needs.

Our structure combines clear leadership intent with empowered teams: each team member is supported by both a People Leader focused on development and a Functional Leader guiding strategy and delivery. We foster autonomy and self-organization to enable fast flow, clear accountability, and minimal dependencies.

The Clinical domain currently consists of three product teams and a data team, supporting our Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biometrics, Clinical Data Management and Clinical Trial Supply functions.

We are seeking a passionate Technical Solution Designer who will be responsible for designing and implementing technical solutions to support CTM and CTS. Practically speaking, you will be the technical expert in how our CTMS, eTMF, and IRT are configured. All of these are SaaS solutions. When our SaaS solutions fall short, you will find ways to deliver functionality in collaboration with our Automation, Integration, AI and Analytics teams.

Together with the IT product team, you will ensure that the solutions, including the documentation packages we deliver, are GxP compliant and sustainable.

You will report to Simon Rønne Kümmel, Clinical Domain Lead, and Jakob Thrane, People Leader. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be to

• Design and implement technical configuration and solutions to support CTM and CTS.

• Engage with stakeholders to understand business needs.

• Either implement the configurations yourself, or work with the managed services provider or vendor to implement the configuration.

• Oversee system support and act as escalation point for tickets.

• Assist with documentation and validation of solutions.

• Be visionary in improving our CTM and CTS supply technical capabilities and suggest and implement improvements for automation, integration and seamless data flows.

• Ensure systems are in a validated state and are inspection-ready.

• Maintain operational oversight over vendors.

Qualifications and experience

You hold a relevant academic degree – preferably a Master’s degree, with a background as an Engineer, Technical Business Analyst, Configuration Manager or an equivalent technical role.

You have solid experience with eTMF and CTMS in a GxP context, minimum +3 years of relevant experience across complex organizations.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong understanding of Clinical Trial Management and Clinical Trial Supply and related systems.

• Experience working with SaaS vendors.

• Ability to connect people and create shared understanding and direction.

• Is good at collaborating with business in complex and ambiguous settings, handling conflicts constructively and helps groups move forward.

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be good at collaborating with business in complex and ambiguous settings, handling conflicts constructively, and helping groups move forward.

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position in an entrepreneurial and international company with short decision paths. You will work with highly skilled colleagues and play a key role in shaping how Global IT delivers sustainable value to Ascendis Pharma and, ultimately, to patients.

Travel: 10-15 days per year

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

Flexibility: Some of the Clinicial organization is located in the US, and meetings in the afternoon and evening will occur.

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Jakob Monajemzadeh Thrane, People Leader, jmt@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website,

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

As the summer holiday period approaches, you may experience a longer response time than usual. We truly appreciate your patience and thank you for your understanding. We look forward to reviewing your application as soon as possible.
